message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.  
In the United States, “local council” isn’t the usual term; instead you’ll contact the **City of Atlanta** through its official channels.

### How to file a noise complaint in Atlanta

| Step | What to do | Where / How |
|------|------------|-------------|
| 1 | Gather details | Note the address, time, duration, and description of the noise. |
| 2 | File online | Use the City of Atlanta’s official website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/> → “Services” → “Noise Complaint.” |
| 3 | Call 311 | Dial **311** (or 404‑727‑3111) from within Atlanta to report the issue. |
| 4 | Contact police | If the noise is urgent or ongoing, you can also call the Atlanta Police Department at **404‑727‑3111**. |

The city’s website will guide you through submitting a form, and you’ll receive a reference number for follow‑up. If you’re outside Atlanta, you can still file online or call 311 from any phone.
